page.layout: One printed page: title page. Large title block at top centre; woodcut engraving in the middle with the monogram C.N.; imprint centred below the engraving; date line at the foot. A handwritten "2" at upper right is not printed.

main_text.l: Anno circiter DCC. vsque ad Annum M. DC. V.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a seated armoured figure with a spear and an open book labelled MEMORIA VITA, a putto above, and the monogram C.N. on a cartouche. No printed text in the engraving beyond the book label and monogram. Italic words: "E" and "P I T O M E" in the first lines are set in italic/large spaced capitals; "Hoc est", "Auctore" are italic. The "& OSTENDÆ" line has spaced capitals.
